policylens.title: PolicyLens
policylens.summary: Check whether one sensitive AWS request became reachable, cite the granting statement and test the correction.
policylens.problem: A policy diff tells a reviewer which JSON changed. PolicyLens evaluates the same sensitive request before and after, cites the granting statement, and checks whether a correction closes that path while preserving required access.
points: The deterministic engine decides permission reachability. The LLM can explain the result but cannot change it.
All 55 documented scenarios match their expected decisions; the AWS simulator cross-check is still pending.
The included fixtures, tests and Docker path run without a cloud account or API key.
policylens.note: Local decision support, not an authorization oracle. SCPs, permission boundaries, session policies and some cross-account interactions remain outside the current model.

projectlens.title: ProjectLens
projectlens.summary: Compare a change narrative with its Primavera schedule, inspect cited conflicts and record the board response.
projectlens.problem: A change pack can tell a different story from the Primavera schedule it cites. ProjectLens puts the conflicts beside their source dates before the board decides. An optional retrieval path finds cited past decisions, then asks the reviewer to use or ignore them.
points: The public Northstar XER runs in the browser and files do not leave the device.
The bundled case surfaces three board blockers, including an unacknowledged 73-day finish movement.
Every finding links to schedule evidence and the reviewer records the decision and follow-up.
projectlens.note: Evidence review does not establish contractual entitlement, causation or a probability of failure. The board keeps decision authority.

quicksupply.title: QuickSupply
quicksupply.summary: A working redesign of an outdated Liverpool supply-cover journey across school, agency and teacher roles.
quicksupply.problem: A local booking process split same-day cover across dated screens and manual follow-up. QuickSupply separates school, agency and teacher work, then makes each assignment and status handoff visible.
points: One request can be followed from school submission through agency assignment to teacher acceptance.
Server-sent events keep the three views in step without manual refresh.
Official DfE vacancy data supplies aggregate market context only; it never ranks an individual teacher.
quicksupply.note: Historical redesign case study, not a live staffing service or a validated startup.

winchester.title: Winchester House Hunter
winchester.summary: A personal property shortlist tied to affordability, commute, condition notes and traced sold-price context.
winchester.problem: A portal listing cannot answer whether one home works for one buyer. House Hunter combines the shortlist with cash position, commute, nearby sold prices, condition notes and next actions.
points: The demo compares nine seeded homes against budget, commute and local completed-sale evidence.
The HM Land Registry market view uses completed sales after published filters, not current listings or valuations.
The public demo separates seeded homes from completed-sale context and states what it cannot decide.
winchester.note: Illustrative only. Listings and figures are seeded examples, not financial, tax, legal or mortgage advice.

lakehouse.title: Marketing ML Lakehouse
lakehouse.summary: A rebuildable local pipeline from source contracts to a leakage-safe next-day prediction task and evidence console.
lakehouse.problem: A notebook can hide the ingestion, lineage and evaluation choices needed to reproduce an analysis. This template records source contracts and checksums, builds Bronze, Silver and Gold tables, then evaluates a next-day target against a persistence baseline with a temporal holdout.
points: A clean command rebuilds the DuckDB lakehouse from committed fixtures and preserves source checksums.
The current fixture surfaces five duplicate campaign/day records before training, then scores next-day predictions against persistence.
An optional adapter maps Google's public GA4 ecommerce sample to the same prospective task without committing the raw export.
lakehouse.note: The public console uses committed fixtures. It does not claim results from a connected advertising account.

hr.title: HR Performance Analytics
hr.summary: A historical Power BI delivery exercise packaged with its artefacts, reproduction notes and a corrected semantic contract.
hr.imageAlt: HR Performance Analytics Power BI dashboard
hr.problem: A dashboard screenshot hides the model, calculations and interpretation choices. This repository keeps the historical artefacts together, points to Microsoft AdventureWorks and records two semantic errors that must be corrected in a rebuild.
points: SickLeaveHours is treated as an available balance, not absence taken; ModifiedDate is not used as age or tenure evidence.
PBIX, PDF, screenshots, SQL and the written correction trail stay together.
A validator checks the 11-file handoff package and semantic contract.
hr.note: The historical PBIX and PDF still carry the old labels. The semantic contract takes precedence until those immutable exports are rebuilt.

england.title: Can England Win It?
england.summary: A one-day World Cup scenario simulator kept as an example of interactive modelling and animation.
england.imageAlt: Can England Win It scenario simulator
england.problem: A tool built for one event loses its purpose when the event ends. This project ran 10,000 seeded simulations per scenario, then closed with the final result and a postmortem.
points: The assumptions stay visible and editable.
Tests cover seeded output, bounds, monotonicity and uncertainty ranges.
The postmortem records what the one-day build achieved and why it stopped.
england.note: A scenario tool for fun, not a forecast or betting product.
